raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  name: qcs-sdk-python
  version: "0.31.1"

recipe:
  name: qcs-sdk-python-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/rigetti/qcs-sdk-rust/archive/refs/tags/lib/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 5e12269b94ddd1538c19111c8a986e460c979972d1e67d2fc1c728dd8778a544

build:
  number: 1

outputs:
  - package:
      name: qcs-sdk-python
    build:
      script:
        env:
          CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: "false"
          CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_CODEGEN_UNITS: "16"
        content:
          - if: win
            then: git config --system core.longpaths true
          - if: unix
            then: export CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/qcs-sdk-cargo-target
            else: set "CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%SystemDrive%\qcs-sdk-cargo-target"
          - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install ./crates/lib -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
          - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('rust') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cargo-bundle-licenses
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - maturin >=1.9.4,<2.0.0
      host:
        - python
        - pip
        - maturin >=1.9.4,<2.0.0
      run:
        - python
        - qcs-api-client-common >=0.26.0,<0.27.0
    tests:
      - if: not (linux and build_platform != target_platform)
        then:
          - python:
              imports:
                - qcs_sdk
                - qcs_sdk.client
                - qcs_sdk.compiler.quilc
                - qcs_sdk.qpu
                - qcs_sdk.qvm
              pip_check: true
      # linux-64 is built on linux-aarch64; run the x86_64 python under qemu-execve
      - if: linux and build_platform != target_platform
        then:
          - script:
              - ${QEMU_EXECVE} ${PREFIX}/bin/python -c "import qcs_sdk, qcs_sdk.client, qcs_sdk.compiler.quilc, qcs_sdk.qpu, qcs_sdk.qvm"
              - ${QEMU_EXECVE} ${PREFIX}/bin/python -m pip check
            requirements:
              build:
                - qemu-execve-${{ target_platform | replace("linux-64", "x86_64") | replace("linux-", "") }} >=11
                - sysroot_${{ target_platform }}
              run:
                - pip
    about:
      license_file:
        - LICENSE
        - THIRDPARTY.yml
        - manual_changes_thirdparty.txt

  - package:
      name: qcs_sdk_python
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("qcs-sdk-python", exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - if: not (linux and build_platform != target_platform)
        then:
          - python:
              imports:
                - qcs_sdk
              pip_check: false
      - if: linux and build_platform != target_platform
        then:
          - script:
              - ${QEMU_EXECVE} ${PREFIX}/bin/python -c "import qcs_sdk"
            requirements:
              build:
                - qemu-execve-${{ target_platform | replace("linux-64", "x86_64") | replace("linux-", "") }} >=11
                - sysroot_${{ target_platform }}

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/rigetti/qcs-sdk-rust
  summary: Defines the Python bindings to make use of the QCS Rust SDK.
  description: |
    Defines the Python bindings to make use of the QCS Rust SDK.
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
  documentation: https://docs.rs/qcs/latest/qcs/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - MementoRC
  feedstock-name: qcs-sdk-python
